subject: [PATCH v2] x86/unaccepted_memory: Do not accept ranges that are no longer E820 RAM

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about the patch's behavior when dealing with partially accepted memory units and suggested refusing memmap= holes in unaccepted memory instead.

reviews.author: Pankaj Gupta
reviews.summary: Agreed with Kiryl's suggestion and decided to drop the original patch in favor of a new series that refuses memmap= holes in confidential guests.

2026-11-13.patch_summary: The patch aimed to reject memory ranges that are no longer E820 RAM, but the author was asked to drop it in favor of a new series.
